name: smart-package-locker
description: Smart Package Locker Management System monorepo: NestJS API (apps/api) + React kiosk UI (apps/web)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
